Instead we can add those methods in SimpleCollectorContext (already there) but need to be accessible via CollectorContext reference. We could cast to SimpleCollectorContext in test, but easier: change collectorContext variable type to SimpleCollectorContext. - Similarly put method: CollectorContext may not have put method; we can add put method in SimpleCollectorContext (already there) but need to be accessible via its type. Change variable type to SimpleCollectorContext.

- childSchema1, childSchema2 are JsonSchema but we need setValidateResult method which only exists in SimpleJsonSchema subclass. So change declarations: private SimpleJsonSchema childSchema1; etc. Also parentSchema can stay JsonSchema.

- SimpleValidatorState overrides methods but they are probably public in base; we need to keep same visibility (public) not weaker. So change to public.
